decls.name: GolodShafarevichInequality

paper_span.quote: If a finite nontrivial pro-\(p\) group has generator

decls.rationale: Proposition 3.4 (Golod–Shafarevich inequality): a finite nontrivial finitely generated pro-p group has \(r > d^2/4\); stated division-free in Lean as \(d(G)^2 < 4\,r(G)\).
